# ShapeHaven Innovations

> ShapeHaven Innovations is a research and software lab. ShapeHaven Innovations LLC is a small, independent team that researches good problems, especially in AI and privacy, and builds iOS and web apps to solve them. Some apps are open source, some are closed source, and some show ads that can be removed with a purchase.

Website: https://shapehaveninnovations.com/
Contact: info@shapehaveninnovations.com
GitHub: https://github.com/Shapehaven-Innovations
Support: https://shapehaveninnovations.com/support (bugs and feature requests via public GitHub issues where a repo exists; everything else via email)

## Positioning

Hero: "Chase good problems." The lab observes things in the wild and fine-tunes solutions through real-world use.

## Products (live, in production)

### ReturnIQ
Shopify app for AI-powered returns management and analytics, helping merchants cut loss and streamline logistics.
- Site: https://returniq.shapehaveninnovations.com/
- Privacy policy: https://shapehaveninnovations.com/returniq-privacy
- Terms of service: https://shapehaveninnovations.com/returniq-terms

### CondoGuard
Property and condo management app for boards, owners, and residents.
- Site: https://condoguard.app/

### KavaCrawl
Social app for discovering new places and people.
- Site: https://kavacrawl.app/

### mDNSShark
mDNS and Bonjour service discovery tool for finding and inspecting devices on a local network.
- Site: https://mdnsshark.shapehaveninnovations.com/

### RhythmX
Private menstrual cycle tracker for iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking; data stays on device.
- Site: https://rhythmx.shapehaveninnovations.com/

## Approach

- Research first, then build. Experience in the field is how solutions get fine-tuned.
- Each app is labeled honestly: open or closed source, ads or no ads.
- We collect only what an app needs to work.

## Field Notes

Notes on software, architecture, DevOps, and tools worth sharing. Author of all posts: ShapeHaven Innovations. RSS feed: https://shapehaveninnovations.com/feed.xml

- [mDNSShark: See Everything on Your Wi-Fi, Without Sending a Byte Out](https://shapehaveninnovations.com/blog/mdnsshark-app) (2026-10-08): Why we built mDNSShark, a free, open-source iPhone network scanner and packet monitor that finds, assesses, and inspects devices on your Wi-Fi entirely on-device, with no telemetry.
- [World Monitor: An Open-Source Dashboard Built for AI Agents](https://shapehaveninnovations.com/blog/worldmonitor-app) (2026-09-03): why an open-source global intelligence dashboard that ships an MCP server alongside its REST API treats AI agents as first-class clients, and why correlation across data feeds is the real product.
